outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic diagram of protein domains, not a plot showing averaged data.
Panel B is a set of epifluorescence micrographs, not a plot.
Panel C is a scatter plot showing mean ± SEM as a bar/line with individual data points (blue open circles) overlaid for each cell measured.
Panel D is a scatter plot showing mean ± SEM with individual data points (yellow open circles) overlaid for each cell measured.
Panel E is a scatter plot showing mean ± SEM with individual data points (green open circles) representing biological replicates.
Panel F contains a scatter plot showing mean ± SEM with individual data points (gray open circles) representing biological replicates, alongside representative disk-diffusion photographs.
Panel G is a set of epifluorescence micrographs, not a plot.
Panel H is a scatter plot showing mean ± SEM with individual data points (blue open circles) overlaid for each cell measured.
Panel I is a scatter plot showing mean ± SEM with individual data points (yellow open circles) overlaid for each cell measured.
Panel J is a Western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
